text:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary wave rolling to eu-west showing elevated 5xx rate (now 7.2% > 5% threshold). Auto-throttle applied to wave-3.

mike: seeing same in grafana, spike started ~7043210900. 5xx is mostly 502 from inference-proxy.

lia: tagging infra & runtime. @sara can you check pool saturation and kvcache logs?

sara: looking — NGINX upstream 502s, backend pods have increased latency and some OOMOOM logs in runtime. grabbing pod logs.

alex: possible noise from quantized model rollout? this wave included q8 rollout for 2 models. if so, prefer immediate pause on model-variant route.

mike: agree. changing route rules to pin traffic to previous stable instance for eu-west. doing a gradual redirect now.

jess: applied route pin; traffic hit stable backend. monitoring.

oncall-bot: action: rollout-pause triggered by mike at 7043211005.

lia: while we stabilize, suggest flipping feature-flag that enabled q8 variants: FF:enable_q8_inference -> false. @alex can you push?

alex: flag toggled to false (console change). propagation started.

sara: logs show error rate falling since route pin + flag flip. 5xx down to 1.1% at 7043211120.

mike: good. customer impact: short-lived errors for eu-west users between 7043210900-7043211100, estimated ~2% of requests retried. No data exposure.

lia: please open incident ticket and assign SEV2, include timeline + affected model variants. I'll take lead for mitigation and next steps.

mike: ticket #INC-2024-879 created. tagging postmortem owners.

oncall-bot: paging rota -> lia (current), mike (previous).

jess: will hold on rollback to previous model image until postmortem confirms root cause; prefer keep q8 disabled and re-run small canary with extra mem.

alex: agree — plan: (1) keep flag off, (2) run isolated canary with increased heap on runtime nodes, (3) collect token-level traces for those requests.

lia: handoff: mike staying to monitor for 30m, then handing to me for postmortem. mike I'm adding you to the incident chatops brief.

mike: ack. I’ll monitor and update if anything regresses. great job everyone. :thumbsup:

lia: adding customer comms note: brief status update to customers in eu-west done. ops notification sent.

oncall-bot: incident closed for rollout stop track at 7043211150 (mitigation in place, monitoring green).
